headline: AgroGalaxy Faces Share Consolidation Notice from B3
summary: AgroGalaxy, currently under judicial recovery, received a notification from the B3 exchange to perform a share consolidation after trading below R$ 1.
why: Exchange compliance notices regarding minimum share prices can lead to corporate restructuring actions such as reverse stock splits.

impacts.name: AgroGalaxy
impacts.why: Company shares are trading below exchange minimums, prompting mandatory corporate restructuring.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
